title: Bachelor of Theology
tagline: A foundational degree in biblical and theological studies
description: The Bachelor of Theology program provides a comprehensive foundation in Old and New Testament studies, systematic theology, church history, and practical ministry. Graduates are equipped to serve effectively as pastors, teachers, and ministry leaders.
eligibility: Personal faith commitment and church recommendation
Willingness to engage in community and practical ministry

faq.question: Is accommodation available for outstation students?
faq.answer: Yes, GEC offers hostel facilities for both male and female students. Contact admissions for availability and fees.

faq.question: Can I work while studying?
faq.answer: The program is full-time and includes field education. Limited part-time ministry roles may be permitted with permission.

faq.question: What is the medium of instruction?
faq.answer: The primary medium of instruction is English, with some courses available in regional languages.

faq.question: Is the B.Th recognized for further study?
faq.answer: Yes, our B.Th degree is accepted for admission into our M.Dv and M.Th programs, and by many seminaries internationally.

title: Master of Divinity
tagline: The professional degree for ministry leadership
description: The Master of Divinity is the standard professional degree for those called to ordained ministry and pastoral leadership. The program deepens biblical, theological, and ministry competencies while emphasizing practical formation.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution
A B.Th or equivalent theological foundation is preferred

faq.question: What is the difference between M.Dv and M.Th?
faq.answer: The M.Dv is a professional ministry degree focused on pastoral and ministry leadership. The M.Th is an academic research degree for those pursuing advanced scholarship or teaching.

faq.question: Are there specialization tracks in the M.Dv?
faq.answer: Yes, students may choose electives focusing on Pastoral Ministry, Youth Ministry, Missions, or Christian Education.

faq.question: Can I pursue M.Dv after completing B.Th at GEC?
faq.answer: Absolutely. GEC B.Th graduates meeting our academic standards are encouraged to continue with M.Dv.

title: Master of Theology
tagline: Advanced scholarship for theological educators and researchers
description: The Master of Theology is a rigorous academic degree for those who wish to specialize in a particular theological discipline and contribute to theological scholarship, teaching, and research.
eligibility: M.Dv or B.Th with distinction from an accredited seminary
Strong academic background with writing and research skills
Proficiency in English; knowledge of Biblical languages preferred
admissionRequirements: M.Dv or B.Th with distinction (minimum 65% or equivalent)

faq.question: Is the M.Th a full-time program?
faq.answer: The M.Th is designed as a full-time program, though limited part-time options may be available. Contact admissions for details.

faq.question: Do I need to know Biblical Greek or Hebrew?
faq.answer: Proficiency in at least one Biblical language is strongly recommended. Students without this background may be required to complete preparatory coursework.

faq.question: Can the M.Th lead to doctoral studies?
faq.answer: Yes. The M.Th is the standard preparation for doctoral (Ph.D. / Th.D.) studies in theology at institutions worldwide.

title: Diploma in Music
tagline: Equipping worship leaders and musicians for ministry
description: The Diploma in Music equips students with both the spiritual and technical skills needed to lead worship and serve in music ministry. The program integrates music theory, instrument training, vocal development, and worship theology.
admissionRequirements: Personal statement on music ministry calling

faq.question: Do I need to play an instrument already?
faq.answer: Basic musical ability is required, but you do not need to be an advanced musician. An audition helps us understand your current level and place you appropriately.

faq.question: What instruments are taught?
faq.answer: The program focuses on keyboard/piano and guitar as primary instruments, with ensemble opportunities on various instruments.

faq.question: Is this program recognized by churches and denominations?
faq.answer: Yes, GEC's Diploma in Music is recognized by numerous churches and denominations for worship leadership roles.
